limitations: Four trials per task is a thin river; per-task rates are rough.
The simulated customer is itself a model, so part of any split may come from the customer, not the agent; recorded runs cannot separate the two (that needs replay from the split point).
Mid-2025 models (GPT-4.1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, o4-mini); this is a study of method and failure shape, not a model ranking.
Runs and grading are Sierra's harness and evaluator (evaluator commit c30d59aa), graded before later task-quality fixes; tasks whose gold actions changed are flagged and excluded from counts.
Retail servicing, not banking; the banking domain is run separately in note 1b.
Tasks were selected on one model's behaviour, which may favour tasks that are unstable for that model.
Cost is τ's recorded API cost at the time of the runs.
